admission.justification: The workspace writer, once-read caller, shared completion choke, admission bound, noncreating stream and maximum-time panel head jointly preserve an attributed bounded completion/feed account. None alone closes that chain; failed writes remain counted only under the existing process-local rule, and the removed lifecycle branch contributes no current obligation.

guarantee: A tool call completed on the host path uses the one workspace-river completion writer for one bounded facts-only event attributed to its once-read caller and its started or addressed role. A failed admitted write is counted in dropped on the next landed row, with no cross-restart promise. There is no current active-lifecycle alternative writer: the retired two-branch member remains historical provenance only. The panel reports who called and the latest feed time, while the shared-lock/missing-lock stream creates, rewrites and deletes no observer file.
